title: 2026-09-28 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：The KV Cache Is the New Memory Wall (机构未标注, KV 缓存取代权重成为长上下文推理的带宽瓶颈)、ActKV (机构未标注, 面向 agent 动作的 KV 压缩，显存降至 26%)、EAServe (University of Oklahoma 等, 多模态 EPD 服务 goodput 提升 4.3×)、DynBranch (机构未标注, agent 分支投机复用降延迟 32%)、WeEnv (Tencent WeChat, agentic RL 环境初始化加速 5.6–14.2×) 等。

highlights.name: The KV Cache Is the New Memory Wall
highlights.note: 系统性综述：KV 缓存取代权重成为长上下文推理瓶颈，给出跨硬件交叉长度

highlights.name: ActKV: Efficient LLM Agents through Action-Guided KV Cache Management
highlights.note: 按动作价值压缩 KV，25.98% 显存保留 98.53% 准确率

highlights.name: EAServe: Encode-Aware Disaggregated Serving for MLLMs
highlights.note: 把 Encode 变成 EPD 流水线控制点，goodput 提升至 4.3×

highlights.name: DynBranch: Speculative Subgraph Reuse for Dynamic Agentic LLM Serving
highlights.note: 让未解析分支提前可寻址，agent 服务延迟最多降 32%

highlights.name: WeEnv: The Environment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning at WeChat
highlights.note: agentic RL 环境税治理，初始化加速 5.6–14.2×，已上生产
